statusText: Mapped policy state: WATCH. Tail has moved to the watch band after a fresh U.S. strike on Iran and an Iranian retaliation vow, while NQ remains closed and the reopening price path is still unobserved.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: WATCH. The principal risk interval is the first four Globex hours, where gap persistence, failed retracements, repeated extension and session-extreme holding determine whether Tail remains elevated.
headline: Fresh U.S.-Iran escalation lifts Tail to WATCH before the Nasdaq futures reopen
body: NQ remains closed until 22:00 UTC. Reuters reported at 20:38 UTC that U.S. forces struck Iranian launchers on Larak Island, the first known U.S. strikes on Iran since late July; Iran's Revolutionary Guards vowed a response. Friday's hawkish Fed repricing and fresh Finviz latest-session semiconductor weakness add Stress, but no live NQ mean-reversion failure is yet observable.

lookbackSummary: From Aug. 29 21:00 UTC through Aug. 30 20:00 UTC, published ChatGPT assessments kept Tail at 19% in normal mode. Stress rose from 79% to 84% as reopening uncertainty accumulated; confidence remained 94-95%.
outlookSummary: Current Tail is WATCH after the fresh Larak escalation. Conditional Tail is highest during the first four Globex hours, when realized gap behavior and retracement quality become observable, then declines if price discovery normalizes. A secondary WATCH checkpoint surrounds Monday's U.S. cash open.

forecast.analysis: Risk remains elevated only if the reopening move still resists meaningful retracement. If early extremes fail to hold or cross-assets diverge, the Tail case should fade even while geopolitical Stress stays extreme.
WATCH reflects residual overnight geopolitical transmission. Tail falls below the block threshold unless repeated extension or a new retaliation headline keeps price discovery one-sided.

As Asian trading develops, the main question is whether the initial reopening impulse has normalized. Two-sided ranges and successful pullbacks would keep Tail in WATCH rather than elevated territory.

Later Asian trading retains a narrow WATCH state because geopolitical headlines can still interrupt normalization. Absent renewed directional efficiency, the probability of prolonged mean-reversion failure continues to recede.
By this hour, the base case is normalization if no new escalation or persistent one-way structure has emerged. Stress can remain extreme-to-high even with Tail back in the low band.
Pre-European trading keeps low Tail under a normalization assumption. A fresh military or shipping escalation would be the principal reason to reprice the path risk upward.
The European cash open creates a cross-asset confirmation checkpoint. WATCH is conditional on European equities, yields and oil reinforcing any overnight NQ direction rather than offsetting it.
After the European open, WATCH persists only if cross-asset alignment reinforces directional NQ structure. Conflicting European signals would favor a return to low Tail.
Mid-morning Europe is a normalization interval unless the overnight move keeps extending without meaningful retracement. No scheduled U.S. Tier-1 release occurs in this hour.
drivers: No Tier-1 U.S. release this hour

forecast.analysis: Low Tail remains the base case if overnight and European trading have developed two-sided structure. Geopolitical headlines remain the main unscheduled source of abrupt repricing.
Ahead of the U.S. morning, Tail stays low unless the overnight move has remained unusually efficient. Rates remain a Stress driver after Friday's hawkish repricing.
The U.S. premarket transition reintroduces WATCH if futures retain an unresolved directional gap. A filled gap or deeper pullback would favor low Tail before the cash open.
The 13:00 UTC hour contains the U.S. cash open at 13:30 UTC. WATCH is conditional on opening-auction continuation, shallow pullbacks and alignment with yields, oil and technology breadth.

The first full post-open hour also contains the Dallas Fed manufacturing release at 14:30 UTC. WATCH reflects the interaction of opening structure with the scheduled data checkpoint, not an assumed release outcome.
After the early U.S. data window, Tail remains WATCH only if the opening move keeps extending after failed retracements. Orderly price discovery would reduce the one-way-path concern.
Midday U.S. trading keeps a marginal WATCH state if directional efficiency remains elevated. A broader two-sided range would return Tail to low despite still-high macro and geopolitical Stress.
Later U.S. trading returns to low Tail under an orderly-session assumption. Geopolitical escalation or renewed session-extreme holding would invalidate that normalization.
Low Tail remains the base case into the afternoon if earlier gaps and extensions have been retraced. Stress stays high because rates and geopolitical transmission remain unresolved.
The approach to power hour remains low Tail unless one-way structure has re-formed. Persistent session-extreme holding would be the main late-day escalation signal.
Into the U.S. close, low Tail assumes no renewed directional break. A late catalyst-driven extension would be a new observation for the next assessment rather than an outcome assumed here.

forecastDetail.comment: Current WATCH reflects the fresh Larak strike and retaliation vow while NQ remains closed; the price-path response is not yet observable.
Elevated reopening risk is conditional on a persistent gap, shallow first pullback, repeated extension or session-extreme holding.
Peak conditional Tail requires continued one-way efficiency after failed counter-moves; meaningful retracements would weaken it.
Elevated Tail persists only if early direction remains efficient; volatility decay or a broader retracement would reduce it.
Risk stays elevated only if the reopening move still resists meaningful retracement; cross-asset conflict would weaken the case.
Residual WATCH remains tied to overnight persistence or new retaliation headlines; repeated extension is not assumed.
